title: Codex trading learning
author: Low-Yellow6950
selftext:
So I've been running this for more than 10 hours. Codex has been educating itself of learning everything about trading. This includes the fundamentals, trading sequences, rules, laws, and patterns. I'm 11 hours in and only hit 0.01%

Mind you, this is on top of 14 skills I've installed. And yes, two of them are token usage.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: 11 hours of reading gets Codex to the point where it can recite the rules. whether any rule it picks makes money is a separate test, and it only passes that one by running the rule over past bars it can't see ahead of. Codex can plug into Quantradin, a tester I built, and get exactly that replay on US stocks and options on paper. costs you nothing, quantradin.com. what is it trying to trade once it's done learning?

replies.author: Low-Yellow6950
replies.body: We are now in the age of learning. Education makes 60% of the business and 40% of it is money that moves it. 95% of people only wants to pay for the information that has been learned.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: people pay for the shortcut, sure. the boring part they skip is running the rule over past bars before any money goes in, and that's usually where the shortcut falls apart.

replies.author: Low-Yellow6950
replies.body: I completely agree. Sure, ai helps speed up the boring parts. But most people just don't bother with it. Maybe that's why so many of us hate going to school. 😂

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: ha, fair. the boring part is still the part that saves the money though.

replies.author: Low-Yellow6950
replies.body: But after its done. I would like to work with you for a professional relationship on this.

comments.author: Critical_Special6790
comments.body: In y’all’s experience, is codex or Claude code better at ai trading? Which have you found to understand the concept and tests more accurately?

comments.author: Technical-Athlete-9
comments.body: How is codex storing the knowledge? Is it building strats in code, making markdown of the rules, etc

replies.author: Low-Yellow6950
replies.body: I have it to do data compression.  It hase 4tb of free memory to utilize and put on the information on. Will it be enough? I will have to see.

replies.author: Technical-Athlete-9
replies.body: Cool. I'm really interested in what you're doing and how the agent is going to use the data you're storing. If you feel comfortable sharing more details about how it works I'd like to learn.

replies.author: Low-Yellow6950
replies.body: I'll be updating once everything is done. Might take a couple months. With codex and anthropic giving away free resets almost every week. I don't have to bother paying for extra tokens.
